name: co.yungle/yungle
description: Ask about your Yungle file deliveries — what was sent, who downloaded, what expires. Read-only.

environmentVariables.name: YUNGLE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A Yungle API key from https://yungle.co/dashboard/settings/api. Reading is free on any account; give the key read scopes only — this server has no tool that writes.

environmentVariables.name: YUNGLE_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Only useful for development against a local Yungle instance; leave unset to use https://yungle.co/api/v1.
